description: Create a gameserver schedule, recurring (`cron`) or one-time (`runOnceAt`); set exactly one of them. action: restart, start, stop, command (needs `command`, sent to the server console), backup (needs ZapX Pass Pro), wipe (only games with a wipe such as Rust, needs `wipe` options). Five-field cron evaluated in `timezone` (IANA, default UTC), at most every 5 minutes, max 20 schedules per server. `runOnceAt` = local "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm" in `timezone`, in the future and at most one year ahead: the schedule runs exactly once and switches itself off. Write both as the customer's local wall-clock time and set `timezone` to their zone, never convert to UTC yourself. To announce a restart, add a second command schedule a few minutes earlier (e.g. cron "55 3 * * *" with command "say Restart in 5 minutes"). Requires confirm=true. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

cron.description: Recurring schedule: five-field cron in local time of `timezone`, e.g. "0 4 * * *" = daily 04:00. At most every 5 minutes. Leave out for a one-time schedule (`runOnceAt`).

runOnceAt.description: One-time schedule: local date and time "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm" in `timezone` (e.g. "2026-11-20T03:00"), in the future and at most one year ahead. Runs exactly once, then switches itself off (isActive=false). Use it for "once tomorrow at 3am", never a cron with a fixed day and month.

serviceId.description: ID of the Gameserver: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_gameservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

timezone.description: IANA zone the cron / runOnceAt is evaluated in, e.g. "Europe/Berlin". Default UTC.

wipe.description: Wipe options, required for action=wipe (only games with a wipe, e.g. Rust).
